director.text: 28 centimetre

Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, parimap kinaara hai: 10 + 4 + 10 + 4 = 28 cm; 10 × 4 andar ki jagah hai. Seedhi bhujaon wali har shape mein har bhuja jodna chalta hai. Ab ek rectangle socho: iski bhujayein jodiyon mein aati hain, aur isse jodne ka ek jaldi wala tareeka milta hai. Is rectangle mein upar aur neeche wali bhuja 10 m ki hai, woh lambai hai. Daayein-baayein wali 6 m ki, woh chaudai. Aamne-saamne ki bhujayein barabar hoti hain. Board par 10 aur 6 ek-ek baar likhe hain, par chakkar lagao toh dono do-do baar milte hain. Yahan tak theek hai?
samajh nahi aaya

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 32 m

Bilkul sahi, kyunki 10 aur 6 dono do-do baar aate hain: 10 + 6 + 10 + 6 = 32 m. Naya rectangle: 12 m lamba, 5 m chauda. Neeche baayein kone se chalo, 12 m aage, phir 5 m upar. Ab tum bilkul saamne wale kone par ho, yaani aadha chakkar. Baaki aadha bhi utna hi lamba hai. Isliye parimap = 2 × (lambai + chaudai). Yahan tak saaf hai?

Ab 2 × (lambai + chaudai) lagao: is rectangle ke liye yeh kitna banta hai?
